title: A tile's trend line that never changes is drawn flat along the bottom
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Flat Shop 14 Oct A).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  • This month every technician's clocked time at {Location-A} is on work order lines only (no internal time), on at least two different days, so Technician Utilization is 100.00% on every day with clocked time.
  • This month {Location-A} has invoices on at least two days with different totals (for example $100.00 on one day and $400.00 on another).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar (the four top tiles open on This Month).
  2. Read the Technician Utilization headline.
  3. Look at the Technician Utilization trend line.
  4. Look at the Revenue trend line.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The headline reads 100.00%.
  • Step 3: The trend line is a flat line along the bottom of the trend area, not in the middle and not at the top. It is not the dashed empty-chart outline.
  • Step 4: The Revenue line uses the whole height of the trend area: its lowest day touches the bottom and its highest day touches the top.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9576 (Story 4, KPI Hero Tiles); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S4-R11b (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward, from Chris Ward's answer 1 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-14), S4-R8 and S4-R12 (since version 42); read 14 Oct 2026. Page change: https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/diffpagesbyversion.action?pageId=788430850&selectedPageVersions=44&selectedPageVersions=45. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R11b: “The sparkline shows direction, not level. Each tile scales its line between its own lowest and highest point, so a figure that never changes over the range (for example Technician Utilization at 100% on every day) draws as a flat line along the bottom of the trend area, whatever the figure is. The headline carries the actual value. The start-at-0 axis of S9-R8 applies to the expanded and report charts, which have an axis, not to the sparkline.”
  • S4-R8: “The Technician Utilization tile headline is the technician utilization percentage for the selected range, shown to two decimal places.”
  • S4-R12: “A tile shows the empty-chart placeholder in place of its sparkline when fewer than two points in the selected range have a value.”
